purpose: Runs Squire's transcription on a file of the owner's that is missing and on one that cannot be read, with a stand-in speech engine and every proxy pointed at a loopback recorder, and checks the job stops with a plain reason, the engine never runs on it, nothing is downloaded or sent, and no file in the owner's folder changes.
title: A missing or unreadable file of the owner's stops the job with nothing downloaded or changed

testCases.description: a missing file stops the job with a plain reason before the engine runs, nothing downloaded, nothing changed
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::a file of the owner's that is missing stops the job with a plain reason before anything runs: nothing downloaded, the engine never run, and no file in the owner's folder changed

testCases.description: a file that cannot be read stops the job with a plain reason, the engine never run on it, nothing downloaded, nothing changed
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::a file of the owner's that cannot be read stops the job with a plain reason: nothing downloaded, the engine never run on it, and no file in the owner's folder changed

testCases.description: a file that opens but that the speech engine cannot read stops the job in Squire's own words, never a crash: non-zero, no note, nothing downloaded or changed
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js::a file of the owner's that opens but that the speech engine cannot read stops the job with a plain reason, never a crash: a non-zero exit, Squire's own words that it could not be read or turned into text, no note kept, nothing downloaded and no file in the owner's folder changed
